name: Jewel Master - Cradle of Rome 2
description:
Write the story of the glorious Roman Empire new, inherit Caesar and create the most powerful building in the most beautiful of all cities!

Swap on the field adjacent symbols to make chains at least three identical treasures and to create resources. Collect like this Gold, jewels, building materials and Food and make a small one Settlement a thriving empire. In Five epochs await you exciting new levels, new ones Bonus tools, new game modes, tricky minigames and beautiful ones Building.
